# T-7: Inject filtered rule block into get-next-action instructions.content

## Goal
Every `flow get next-action` response prepends the phase- and state-filtered rule block to instructions.content; other envelope fields are unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- State derivation: worktree → worktreeActive, autoApprove → autoApproveOn.
- Filter against the active scope-aware step id.
- Zero-match yields no prepend.
- Auto-promotion path injects rules for the promoted step id.

## Implementation Notes
Modify `src/flow/lib/get-next-action.js`; call into the loader; do not break existing snapshot tests of envelope shape.

## Test Strategy
Integration tests with multiple flow.json fixtures (worktree on/off, autoApprove on/off, no in_progress step).
